title: Union Budget 2026-27 announces Khelo India Mission with ₹4,479.88 Crore outlay
summary: Highest-ever sports budget allocation: ₹4,479.88 Cr for Sports Ministry, ₹924.35 Cr for Khelo India scheme, ₹500 Cr for sports goods manufacturing.
